header: Week of Monday 28 September 2026 — built 2026-09-28 from 100 daily snapshots (2026-06-17 to 2026-09-28), 4,633 pieces with a price record across 214 labels.
554 pieces changed price and 497 of those moves are confirmed by a later snapshot; the biggest is 51% at Gaudir Swim.
284 pieces are down to one or two in-stock sizes from a run of four or more, and 817 were listed by their own shop in the last 7 days.
